lessons_content_by_type.name: lessons_content_by_type
lessons_content_by_type.value: ("lessons"."type" = 'article' and "lessons"."body" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'video' and "lessons"."video_url" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'pdf' and "lessons"."file_id" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'link' and "lessons"."external_url" like 'https://%')

surveys_launched_has_dates.name: surveys_launched_has_dates
surveys_launched_has_dates.value: "surveys"."status" = 'draft' or ("surveys"."launched_at" is not null and "surveys"."closes_at" is not null)

home_banners_period.name: home_banners_period
home_banners_period.value: "home_banners"."ends_at" is null or "home_banners"."starts_at" is null or "home_banners"."ends_at" > "home_banners"."starts_at"
